**Open Research Statement**

<Check version before finalisation>

Data used in this study were extracted from the Melbourne Water Macroinvertebrate Database (Version 2.1.1, available at <https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwbugs/data/mwbugs_db_v2.1.1.gpkg>) and the Melbourne Water Stream Network Database (Version 1.3.1, available at <https://tools.thewerg.unimelb.edu.au/mwstr/data/mwstr_v1.3.1.gpkg>). All code and documentation relating to the manuscript is stored in a github repository available at <https://github.com/tewilkins/bulk_processing_experiment_modelling>.

**Keywords**

forest cover, imperviousness, spatial arrangement, macroinvertebrates, metabarcoding, hyperparameter tuning

**Ethics Statement**

All sampling was conducted in accordance with relevant Australian legislation and regulations governing the collection of freshwater macroinvertebrates. Samples were collected under the relevant permits issued by [Parks Victoria; AA-0241308]. Sampling procedures were designed to minimise impacts on organisms and their habitats. No animals were experimentally handled or subjected to procedures requiring animal ethics approval.
